title: fire pit grate
text: fire pit grate. Fits perfectly in our smallish chimenia which is roundish at the base, typical of most chimenias.  It is cast iron and the opening is fairly small, however this grate fit in sideways and then straightened out.  It works exactly as it should, creating air below the fire. It is black, just as shown.  It did kind of smell funky but it was going outside, so not worried.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and will answer questions and comments asap.
